cause: The v1 run identity did not use the application-qualified prefix required by the signer host. All ephemeral signer services therefore rejected startup before keys or signed evidence existed.
interpretation: This is a packet-binding failure before the intended fault injection, not evidence for or against uncertain-write handling.
nextAction: Register a fresh v2 identity using the accepted mode-r-application prefix. Keep the injection schedule and acceptance thresholds unchanged.
claimBoundary: V1 is a failed development attempt with no signed run evidence and no scientific result. It does not qualify uncertainty handling or close B12.
